en: The postcard shows a hand-colored photograph of a grand European square with a prominent fountain, lush gardens, and elegant buildings with ornate facades. People are seen strolling the park in period clothing. The caption on the front reads 'Sundsvall. Wångåfvan.' The back features Swedish text and a green Swedish stamp, addressed to 'Fröken Tora Cederholm' in Sundsvall.
